semantic_overlap.judgment: Distinct plain-line versus quoted structured-row semantics, provided exact match and first-occurrence behavior remain explicit.

Shared spreadsheet reconciliation; status denominator, donated-goods custody and inventory cutoff materially distinguish the actual records.
Contract/quote arithmetic across variants; match actual scope/unit/period and document evidence rather than count title changes as new methods.

limits: This report is source semantic applicability and gap review, not evidence that any workflow executed successfully.
